about: card plate: the arrival glow, the card title alignment, the edge, the chip look and the folded (key + detail) look. ctl-*: the pin and close buttons (size, offsets from the top-right corner, gap between them); pin-icon / x-icon their glyphs. edge-base-a: the faint accent rim of a folded card; edge-glow-*: the soft accent glow inside a folded card's edge (blur radius, strength, hue drift); edge-shimmer-ms: one slow breath of it; edge-shimmer-laps / edge-fade-ms: how many breaths on arrival before it fades away for good. compact-text-lines: the lines a folded paragraph shows. compact-text-w / text-open-w: a folded paragraph's box width and its width once open.
